)

for n in (3,4,5):
 typ=f'Either{n}['+', '.join(['int']*n)+']'
 s+=f'\\nfunc TestEither{n}BinarySerialization(t *testing.T) {{\\n'
 s+=f' originals := []{typ}{{\\n'
 for i in range(1,n+1): s+=f' {{argId: either{n}ArgId{i}, arg{i}: {i*10}}},\\n'
 s+=' }\\n for _, original := range originals {\\n'
 s+=''' data, err := original.MarshalBinary()
 if err "'!= nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if data[0] != byte(original.argId) { t.Fatalf("unexpected side id: %d", data[0]) }
 var payload int
 if err := gob.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data[1:])).Decode(&payload); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if payload != (int(original.argId)+1)*10 { t.Fatalf("unexpected payload: %d", payload) }
'"'''
 s+=f' decoded := {typ}{{'+', '.join(f'arg{i}: 99' for i in range(1,n+1))+'}\\n'
 s+=''' if err := decoded.UnmarshalBinary(data); err "'!= nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if !decoded.Equal(original) { t.Fatalf("binary round trip: got %#v, want %#v", decoded, original) }
 var buf bytes.Buffer
'"'''
 s+=f' holder := struct {{ Value {typ} }}{{original}}\\n'
 s+=''' if err := gob.NewEncoder(&buf).Encode(holder); err "'!= nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 decodedHolder := holder
 if err := gob.NewDecoder(&buf).Decode(&decodedHolder); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if !decodedHolder.Value.Equal(original) { t.Fatalf("gob round trip: got %#v, want %#v", decodedHolder.Value, original) }
 }
'"'''
 s+=f' var decoded {typ}\\n'
 s+=f' for _, data := range [][]byte{{nil, {{}}, {{255}}, {{{n}}}, {{0}}, {{0, 255}}}} {{\\n'
 s+=' if err := decoded.UnmarshalBinary(data); err == nil { t.Fatalf(\"expected error for %v\", data) }\\n }\\n'
 s+=f' invalid := {typ}{{argId: -1}}\\n if _, err := invalid.MarshalBinary(); err == nil {{ t.Fatal(\"expected invalid side error\") }}\\n'
 ft=f'Either{n}['+', '.join(['func()']+['int']*(n-1))+']'
 s+=f' unsupported := {ft}{{arg1: func() {{}}}}\\n if _, err := unsupported.MarshalBinary(); err == nil {{ t.Fatal(\"expected gob encoding error\") }}\\n}}\\n'
Path('either_binary_test.go').write_text(s)

item.text:
Added all four serialization methods to `Either3`, `Either4`, and `Either5`.

Encoding prefixes the gob payload with the side id. Decoding clears inactive sides and rejects empty input or unknown ids. Gob methods delegate to the binary methods.

Added tests for every side, struct gob round trips, stale-value clearing, and invalid inputs. `go test ./...` passes.
